$doc.purpose: Repos opted in to post-merge herdr verification dispatch (issue #1511).
$doc.note: Keys starting with '$' are reserved metadata and are never a repo slug. Every other top-level key is an 'owner/repo' slug; an unlisted repo means the feature is skipped entirely.
$doc.verify_skill_allowlist: verify_skill is allowlisted to 'devx:pr-verify-merged' or 'devx:pr-verify-live'. It is typed into the prompt of a session started with --dangerously-skip-permissions, so any other value is refused with one [WARN] before any herdr call.

dEitY719/dotfiles.note: No long-running app to point a browser at, so the proof has to come from a fresh clone of the merge commit — devx:pr-verify-merged, not -live.
